description: Providing tax concessions on dates imported for free distribution during the Ramazan fasting period
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-29 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Dates, which are specially consumed by Muslim devotees during the Ramazan fasting period, are donated or gifted annually to them diplomatically, in organizational levels and by individuals for free distribution, and those should be imported to the country on the basis of not spending foreign exchange. This year's Ramazan fasting season is scheduled to begin on 2026-02-19 and end on 2026-03-21. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to provide a tax concession on the dates imported to the country as donations and gifts during the Ramazan festive season, was approved by the Cabinet.
